dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgUpdatePara.title: UpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgUpdatePara.description: UpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.  * UpdateParams updates module parameters. Behavior: - Authority-only: verifies msg.Authority matches the module's configured authority. - Parameter validation: validates all parameter constraints (pfand amounts, time durations, percentage bounds, block delays). - State update: persists validated parameters to the module's parameter store. Validation: - Authority must match the module's configured authority address. - Parameters must pass Params.Validate() which checks:   - PfandPerOffer denom set when amount > 0   - ValuationPeriod > 0   - BidTimeout > 0   - ValuationFeePct in [0,1) if set   - MinimumBidPercentIncrease in [0,1) if set   - BlockDelayBeforeClose > 0   - BlockDelayBeforeLiquidation > 0 Returns: - MsgUpdateParamsResponse (empty) on success.

minimum_bid_percent_increase.description: minimum_bid_percent_increase specifies the minimum percent increase required over the current valuation for a new bid to be accepted.
